scope: Prevent dx_iface::writeEntity from serializing a derived MESH or HELIX runtime object through a built-in base writer while silently dropping subclass state.

implementation.failureBehavior: A derived runtime class with the matching public tag is refused through the existing atomic output path before the base writer is called.
implementation.retryBehavior: Replacing the derived object with the exact built-in class permits same-adapter retry.

validationProfile.source: Locally constructed DRW_Mesh and DRW_Helix subclasses with extra unmodeled string state; exact retry models are authored in memory. No drawing fixture is used.
assertions: Both derived runtime classes are refused despite carrying their matching MESH or HELIX public tag.
Each refusal preserves a pre-existing destination sentinel.
Exact DRW_Mesh retry reads back the three vertices and triangular face indices.
Exact DRW_Helix retry reads back its runtime type, two fit points, and selected axis/turn fields.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; existing tag-mismatch controls plus four MESH/HELIX subclass refusal/retry/readback cases across ASCII and Binary DXF, 0.63 seconds.
validation.fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was added or committed.

limitations: The guard covers the concrete dx_iface adapter dispatch; direct public dxfRW::writeMesh and writeHelix calls are outside this slice.
No physical DWG producer profile, topology/kernel meaning, native consumer behavior, ABI behavior, or whole-document output is qualified.
P8 remains open and no support claim is promoted.
